points.description: States that a function signature is the function's name together with its parameter list (parameter types), i.e. what identifies/declares the function apart from its body.
points.partial_credit: Give about 2.5 marks if only the function name or only the parameters/types is mentioned, or the answer is vaguely about the function declaration without naming these parts.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the signature is the function name plus its parameters (types), in any wording, even briefly. Part marks (about half) if only the name or only the parameters/types is given, or the answer is a vague description of the function declaration. Zero if unrelated, e.g. only describing what a function does. Extra correct detail such as return type is fine.
